literal_meaning: বুদ্ধি হত/নষ্ট হয়ে যাওয়া (intellect destroyed or stunned)
figurative_meaning_bn: করণীয় বিষয় স্থির করতে না পারা
figurative_meaning_en: Unable to decide on the course of action; being perplexed or indecisive
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খবর শুনে হতবুদ্ধি হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He was dumbfounded upon hearing the news.
Everyone is at a loss in this complicated situation.
note: The idiom draws from Sanskrit roots, common in classical Bengali literature.
